name: Boom Bap Hip Hop
description: Classic sampled loop structure with filtered intro, 16-bar verses, a vocal hook, and beat drop-outs.

defaults.concept: Classic boom bap hip hop — gritty, unquantized kick-snare transients, vinyl-filtered sample loops, a swinging pocket with beat drop-outs for vocal punctuation.

slots.label: Filtered Sample Intro
slots.purpose: FEEL: Muffled, historical, vinyl character. TRICK: Apply a steep low-pass filter to the main chord loop. Keep the drum track entirely muted so the groove is felt before the full track hits.

slots.label: 16-Bar Verse Core
slots.purpose: FEEL: Hard-hitting, gritty, swinging pocket. PRODUCTION NOTE: Pop open the filter sweep. Unleash the heavy, unquantized kick-snare transient positions. The harmonic loop cycles rigidly every 4 bars.

slots.label: The Vocal Hook
slots.purpose: FEEL: Focused and anthemic. TRICK: Overlay a minor melodic asset (like a background horn snippet or turntable scratch line) to signify the hook block without changing the underlying main chords.

slots.label: The Beat Drop Out
slots.purpose: FEEL: High vocal exposure. TRICK: Drop the drum MIDI clips out completely on measures 2 and 4 of this block to punctuate the lyricist's line delivery.
